source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (Instagram OR "social media") AND ("urban imaginaries" OR "representation of the city" OR "city image")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(Instagram OR "social media") AND ("urban imaginaries" OR "representation of the city" OR "city image"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("Instagram" OR "social media") AND ("city image" OR "representation of the city" OR "urban imaginaries"))
